pricing.simpleTransparentPricingDescription: One plan, no surprises. Pay a flat base fee plus a small amount per active worker — nothing else.
pricing.faq1Q: How is the monthly cost calculated?
pricing.faq1A: You pay a flat base fee of {{baseFee}}€/month, plus {{perWorkerFee}}€ for each active worker. For example, 10 workers costs {{baseFee}}€ + (10 × {{perWorkerFee}}€) = 90€/month.
pricing.faq2A: No. The base fee and the per-worker rate are the only charges. No setup fee, no onboarding fee, no per-project fee.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I add or remove workers at any time?
pricing.faq3A: Yes. Adding workers takes effect immediately and is prorated for the rest of the billing cycle. Removing workers takes effect at the start of the next billing period.
pricing.faq4Q: Are there any hidden fees or long-term contracts?
pricing.faq4A: No hidden fees and no contracts. You pay month-to-month and can cancel any time from your account settings. Your access continues until the end of the paid period.
pricing.faq5Q: What do workers need to use the app?
pricing.faq5A: Workers install the free Koordinate app on their Android or iOS phone. You invite them with a code — no email address required. They never see any billing information.
pricing.faq6Q: How does location tracking work for workers?
pricing.faq6A: When a worker checks in to an assignment, the app tracks their GPS location in the background and sends periodic updates. Tracking stops automatically when they check out. Workers are informed of tracking in the app.

privacy.title: Location & Privacy
privacy.intro: Before you start, here is how Koordinate uses your data.
privacy.locationBody: The app collects your GPS location in the background while you are checked in to a work session. Tracking stops automatically when you check out. Location data is only visible to your employer.
privacy.dataBody: Work session start and end times, GPS location events during active sessions, and your profile information (name, email).
privacy.retentionBody: GPS data is deleted after 90 days. Work hour records are kept for up to 10 years for payroll compliance.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting your employer or Koordinate at info@koordinate.app.
privacy.poweredBy: Your data is processed by Koordinate under GDPR.
